Before running anything I re-read the tests and found three problems:
- `deadlineDoer` uses a value receiver, so `sawDeadline` never gets set.
- The 24-hour check in the owner-email test is weak: any two failures are at least 34 hours apart, so it never exercises the suppression window.

Definition of done:
- Failed deliveries are retried on the schedule 1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 8h, 24h (7 attempts in all). A 410 fails at once and disables the endpoint (`enabled` false, `disabled_reason` "gone"), so its other pending deliveries are not sent. After the 7th failure, every owner gets one "Webhook endpoint failing: <URL>" email per endpoint per 24 hours. The delivery JSON shows attempts, last_attempt_at, next_attempt_at (null when none is planned), response_status and error.
- Checked with new tests in `internal/webhooks` for the schedule, 3xx, no answer, timeout, 410, owner email and the 24-hour limit, plus the existing test updated to the retry behaviour. `go build ./...`, `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...` all pass.
- Existing exported names and signatures stay as they are; `Options` gains `Mail`.

## What changed

- **`internal/webhooks/webhooks.go`**
  - `retryDelays` and `maxAttempts` (7) drive the schedule. Each wait is counted from the failed attempt's clock reading.
  - `deliver` now returns whether it made an attempt. It re-reads the delivery under the lock, so one that an earlier 410 in the same run already failed is not sent.
  - A delivery that cannot be sent (endpoint disabled or deleted, event gone) fails for good without counting as an attempt.
  - `RunDue` returns the number of attempts made. It also returns any mail error joined, so the demo job logs it.
  - A 410 disables the endpoint and fails its other pending deliveries. It sends no email, because the spec only ties email to the 7th failure.
  - The 24-hour email limit is kept in memory on the Service. The store is in-memory anyway, so a restart loses it in the same way.
  - A response body that fails to finish within the 10-second deadline now counts as a failed attempt.
- **`internal/store/types.go`**: `next_attempt_at` no longer has `omitempty`, so it shows `null`.
- **`internal/apitest/apitest.go`**: passes `Mail: e.Mail` to the webhooks service.
- **`cmd/tally/main.go`**: creates the outbox before the webhooks service and passes it to both services. Without this, the demo server would swallow owner emails.
- **`internal/webhooks/webhooks_test.go`**
  - The existing test asserted that a 500 fails for good with no retry. That contradicts the new requirement, so I changed it to assert pending with one attempt and a retry 1 minute later. I did not weaken the test otherwise.
  - New tests: full 7-attempt schedule (including one second early and not due), 3xx/no answer/2xx, timeout deadline, 410 handling, and owner emails (owners only, one per endpoint per 24 hours, re-sent after a day).

## Choices to check

- A delivery whose endpoint is disabled by a user (not by a 410) also fails for good without an attempt, as it did before. Re-enabling the endpoint does not revive it.
- The 410 path sends no owner email.
